lxc_42b12d2c8e5a6823.text: The 2026 World Cup was different from older tournaments.

lxc_5290be23992d02a3.text: For the first time, 48 teams played.

lxc_38e54770613f955e.text: That is more teams than ever before.

lxc_5664fe5ee9e879be.text: Three countries hosted the tournament together: Canada, Mexico, and the United States.

lxc_cf1bfcb4f0a49a15.text: The tournament started in June 2026 and the final was on 19 July 2026.

lxc_2725dbefb3dcf06a.text: Sometimes a match ends 0–0 or with the same score after 90 minutes.

lxc_7bd2c9422507fff7.text: In a final, there must be a winner.

lxc_58be12fdc2f90dae.text: So the teams play extra time — two more short halves.

lxc_b84cfee54b4ce67b.text: If the score is still equal after extra time, the teams use a penalty shoot-out.

lxc_c55f79f349eee476.text: Each team takes turns kicking the ball from the penalty spot.

lxc_72d5d53cc090d338.text: In the 2026 final, Spain scored in extra time, so there was no penalty shoot-out.

lxc_7fe18a98c177b2da.text: The final match was on 19 July 2026 in New York/New Jersey.

lxc_88769232fc035f37.text: In extra time, Spain scored one goal.

lxc_52f21739cbd34d4b.text: Spain became the 2026 World Cup champions.

lxc_a29cbd8e47b66a64.text: The FIFA World Cup is a football tournament.

lxc_c7aeb07752bc14f9.text: Teams from around the world play against each other.

lxc_9c49bf9033d321fb.text: One team wins and becomes world champion.

lxc_80cc384c45b939ae.text: A football match has two teams.

lxc_911152f29ab98499.text: Each team has up to eleven players.

lxc_c5730a91640c1a7a.text: One player on each team is the goalkeeper.

lxc_0c83e676bf43f9d8.text: The match has two halves of 45 minutes each.

lxc_e90333a420062850.text: The team that scores more goals wins.
